name: two_asset_var_backtest_capital_charge
question_template: A two-asset portfolio has value V={V} USD, weight w1={W1} percent in asset 1 and the rest in asset 2. Daily volatilities are s1={S1} percent and s2={S2} percent; return correlation is rho={RHO}. One-day diversified VaR is V times the supplied quantile z={Z} times portfolio daily volatility (variance-covariance, zero mean); scale it to h={H} trading days by the square root of time. The average holding-period VaR over the prior 60 days is a={A} percent of V. Backtesting over 250 days gave n={N} exceptions. Multiplier k is 3 plus an add-on: 0 for n at most 4; 0.40, 0.50, 0.65, 0.75, 0.85 for n of 5, 6, 7, 8, 9; 1.00 for n of 10 or more. Compute the capital charge in USD as the larger of the holding-period VaR and k times the 60-day average VaR; round only the final value half up to 2 decimal places.

slots.description: Exact one-day VaR in USD ignoring diversification.
Diversified VaR in USD at the holding period.

program:
def solve():
    V = Q(P["V"])
    w1 = Q(P["W1"]) / 100
    w2 = 1 - w1
    s1 = Q(P["S1"]) / 100
    s2 = Q(P["S2"]) / 100
    rho = Q(P["RHO"])
    z = Q(P["Z"])
    h = P["H"]
    a = Q(P["A"]) / 100
    n = P["N"]
    undiv = V * z * (w1 * s1 + w2 * s2)
    var_p = (w1 * s1) ** 2 + (w2 * s2) ** 2 + 2 * rho * w1 * w2 * s1 * s2
    if var_p <= 0:
        raise ValueError("non-positive portfolio variance")
    sig = sqrt(var_p)
    div1 = V * z * sig
    varh = div1 * sqrt(h)
    addons = {5: Q("0.40"), 6: Q("0.50"), 7: Q("0.65"), 8: Q("0.75"), 9: Q("0.85")}
    if n <= 4:
        addon = Q(0)
    elif n >= 10:
        addon = Q(1)
    else:
        addon = addons[n]
    k = 3 + addon
    avg = V * a
    final = max(varh, k * avg)
    return {
        "final": final,
        "undiversified_one_day_var": undiv,
        "diversified_one_day_var": div1,
        "holding_period_var": varh,
        "regulatory_multiplier": k,
    }
